services.desc: You probably chose Maricopa to live in because it is quiet and calm, and close enough to the city when you feel like making the drive. You enjoy your afternoons at Copper Sky Recreation Complex, your weekends at Ak-Chin Southern Dunes, family time at Pacana Park, and laid-back evenings around Maricopa’s growing restaurant and entertainment scene. There’s a lot to like about life here: wide-open neighborhoods, desert sunsets, local parks, golf, community events, and that balance between everyday comfort and Arizona adventure.
